description: Backend RAG pipeline: dependencies, models, migration, document loaders, chunker, embedder, vector store, ingestion pipeline, retriever, and knowledge API endpoints
steps: 1. Add dependencies to apps/api/pyproject.toml: pymupdf, python-docx, fastembed, tiktoken. Run `uv sync` to install.

2. Create apps/api/app/model/knowledge_document.py with KnowledgeDocument model: id (UUID pk), user_id (FK users.id), name (str), source_file_id (FK files.id nullable), title (str nullable), tags (ARRAY of String), language (str nullable), status (str: processing|ready|failed), chunk_count (int default 0), error_message (str nullable), created_at (DateTime with timezone).

3. Create apps/api/app/model/kb_chunk.py with KBChunk model: id (UUID pk), document_id (FK knowledge_documents.id), chunk_index (int), text (Text), page (int nullable), section (str nullable), token_count (int), qdrant_point_id (str nullable), created_at (DateTime with timezone).
4. Register both models in apps/api/app/model/__init__.py following the existing pattern (import after Base, add to __all__).

5. Create alembic migration apps/api/alembic/versions/003_add_knowledge_tables.py (revision='003', down_revision='002') creating knowledge_documents and kb_chunks tables with proper columns, FKs, and indexes.

7. Create apps/api/app/rag/loaders.py with functions: load_pdf(path)->list[dict], load_docx(path)->list[dict], load_txt(path)->list[dict]. Each returns list of {'text': str, 'page': int|None, 'section': str|None}. Use pymupdf for PDF, python-docx for DOCX.

8. Create apps/api/app/rag/chunker.py with recursive text splitter: target 512 tokens, overlap ~77 tokens (15%), split on paragraph > sentence > fixed size. Use tiktoken cl100k_base for counting. Return list of Chunk dataclass/namedtuple(text, page, section, chunk_index, token_count).

9. Create apps/api/app/rag/embedder.py using fastembed with model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384 dimensions). Functions: embed_texts(texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]], embed_query(query: str) -> list[float]. Use singleton pattern for model loading.

10. Create apps/api/app/rag/vector_store.py wrapping qdrant_client. Functions: ensure_collection(user_id) creates collection 'kb_{user_id}' if not exists (cosine distance, 384 dims), upsert_chunks(user_id, chunks_with_vectors, metadata), search(user_id, query_vector, top_k=8, filters=None)->list[SearchResult], delete_document(user_id, document_id). Use QdrantClient(url=settings.QDRANT_URL).

11. Create apps/api/app/rag/ingest.py with ingest_document(db_session, user_id, document_id, file_path, file_type) that: loads doc, chunks text, embeds chunks, upserts to Qdrant, saves KBChunk records to DB, updates KnowledgeDocument status. Handle errors by setting status='failed'.

12. Create apps/api/app/rag/retriever.py with retrieve(db_session, user_id, query, top_k=8, document_ids=None)->list[RetrievalResult] that: embeds query, searches Qdrant (with document_id filter if provided), returns results with text, score, doc_name, page, section.

13. Create apps/api/app/schema/knowledge.py with Pydantic schemas: KnowledgeDocumentResponse, KnowledgeDocumentCreate (optional title, tags), KBSearchRequest (query, top_k, document_ids), KBSearchResult, KBSearchResponse.

14. Create apps/api/app/router/knowledge.py with APIRouter(prefix='/kb', tags=['knowledge']): POST /documents (upload+ingest, multipart), GET /documents (list), GET /documents/{id} (detail), DELETE /documents/{id} (delete doc+chunks+vectors), POST /search (RAG search). Accept PDF/DOCX/TXT MIME types.
15. Register the knowledge router in apps/api/app/main.py and apps/api/app/router/__init__.py.
16. Modify apps/api/app/schema/conversation.py MessageCreate to add optional field: kb_document_ids: list[str] | None = None.

17. Modify apps/api/app/router/conversations.py create_message endpoint: when kb_document_ids is provided, call retrieve() to get relevant chunks, inject them into the system prompt as RAG context with citation markers [^N], and after LLM response emit SSE 'citation' events with source info.
18. Run `cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . --fix` to ensure code passes linting.
acceptance_criteria: uv sync installs all new dependencies without errors
All new model files are importable and consistent with existing patterns
Alembic migration file 003 exists with correct schema
All RAG modules (loaders, chunker, embedder, vector_store, ingest, retriever) are importable
Knowledge router registered and endpoints accessible
Conversations endpoint handles RAG context injection
ruff check passes on all new code
